title: Psalm 30: Mourning Turned to Dancing
summary: A man who came near to death thanks the LORD for lifting him out of Sheol and healing him. He invites God's faithful people to sing with him, confesses that in easier days he thought he could never be shaken, recalls the desperate prayer he prayed when God hid his face, and ends by promising thanks forever because God turned his mourning into dancing.

from.where: The Study Bible's introduction to the Psalms
from.text: Songs of thanksgiving tell how God rescued someone, so that others can praise him too (Psalms 30, 34, 116).

line: A man brought back from near death thanks the LORD who healed him, admits he once thought he could never be shaken, and praises the God who turned his mourning into dancing.
guide: Remember a time God brought you through, and say it aloud to others; thanks shared becomes someone else's hope. Then ask what you trusted when things were easy, and answer before the next hard time comes.

stanzas.title: Thanks for rescue from death and the gloating of enemies
A call to the saints: his anger is brief, his favor lasting
The false security of prosperity and the hidden face
The prayer he prayed in the dark, remembered
Mourning turned to dancing and a vow of endless thanks

verses.t: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
“What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
